name: Angular
description: An Angular single-page app with standalone components, signals and a generated OpenAPI client.

specSections.title: Data Sources & Consumed APIs
specSections.guidance: There is no backend or database in this stack. List every data source and third-party API the frontend consumes: base URL and endpoints used, authentication (public keys only, never secrets in the browser), CORS and rate limits, the response fields the UI relies on, where in the app each is called, caching, and how failures, empty results and offline states are shown. Static or bundled data: name its file and how it is updated.

order.reason: Change the API contract before the frontend steps that update the generated client from it.

generatedFiles.ciCheck: cd {fe} && npm run gen:api && git diff --exit-code src/app/api/generated

requiredEnv.description: The backend origin, written into assets/config.json at build or container start (cross-origin only).
The Supabase project URL, written into assets/config.json at build (public).
The Supabase publishable key (sb_publishable_...), written into assets/config.json at build (public).

checklist.item: Standalone components, signals, built-in control flow, inject(), and no leaking subscriptions.
Only the generated Orval services are used, and they match the current contract.
The interceptor maps problem details, and guards and permissions come from the spec.
Every state is present, accessibility basics are met, and it works at 360px.
Tests cover the FRs, and the gate passes.

gate: cd {fe} && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
